description: This file defines a custom DQL function 'TimeDiff' for Doctrine ORM, which calculates the difference between two datetime expressions in specified units (minutes, hours, or default seconds). It includes parsing logic and SQL generation for the function.
external_files: Doctrine ORM classes: Lexer, Parser, SqlWalker, FunctionNode

classes.name: TimeDiff
classes.description: A Doctrine ORM custom function node that computes the time difference between two date/time expressions in specified units.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the arguments for the TimeDiff function, expecting two date/time expressions and a unit type.

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL expression for the time difference calculation based on the specified unit type.
